BiblicalUsage: In Aramaic this is the number four. Four winds strive on the great sea, four great beasts come up from the sea, the four beasts are four kings who rise from the earth, and at the dedication of the house of God the people offer four hundred lambs.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that four in Daniel is the number of the kingdoms of the earth, complete in their pride. Every one of them is measured against the kingdom that has no number and no end.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
